summary: Executed first-checkpoint verification for android/vesper-native with new deterministic JVM/MockWebServer/Robolectric suites plus external read-only backend contract smoke. ui_bugs.issue: Back from Detail did not restore previously focused poster tag in Robolectric lifecycle test (expected exact tile restore, got null focus tag).

integration_issues.issue: Search aggregation keeps duplicate title IDs across media types because dedupe key is type+id (Title.key), so same content ID from movie/series catalogs is returned twice.

Decide and implement intended dedupe strategy for search results when identical IDs appear across multiple searchable catalogs/media types.
Re-run :app:testDebugUnitTest after fixing the above two failures.
If required, run physical-device validation for focus outlines/clipping and signout dialog interaction (Robolectric dialog inspection boundary).

Current failing native tests are: MainActivity focus restore after Back from Detail, and CatalogRepository search duplicate handling across sources/types. assembleDebug succeeded and APK copied to /app/test_reports/vesper_native/app-debug-iteration117.apk. External backend URL smoke is REAL (not mocked) and passed.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (focus restore): NativeScreen.hidden stores focusKey from root.findFocus(), but in tested Back path from Detail the previous Home tile focus was not restored (null tag on return), indicating focus state retention/rehydration gap in screen stack transition. RCA-2 (search duplicates): CatalogRepository.search combines per-catalog results and dedupes by Title.key (=type:id), which preserves duplicates when identical title IDs surface under different media types/catalogs. Mitigation: refine dedupe identity (e.g., stable content id normalization) per desired product behavior.
